pr_title: Convert core xpack rest tests to new test framework
pr_body:
This converts the x-pack core YAML tests to using the new test clusters testing framework.

Fixes #95334

review_comments: Is this missing an `=true`? This PR seems to have caused #100362, so I think there's _something_ different to before about the way the feature flag is set in release builds.
I think you're right. I'll get this fixed.
